name: tensorflow
description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
one_liner: Google's free foundational toolkit for building and training machine learning models, used by engineers rather than end users.
buyer: A company that needs a custom machine-learning model (fraud detection, demand forecasting) but doesn't have in-house ML engineers to build it from scratch.
business_use_cases: An ML consulting shop builds custom forecasting or classification models for retail and finance clients using it as the underlying engine.
A hardware vendor optimizes and sells TensorFlow-based inference on specialized edge devices.
A SaaS company trains a proprietary model on its own data and sells access to the predictions, never exposing the framework itself.

money_ideas.idea: Offer ML-model-as-a-service consulting: build and deploy one custom model per client engagement.
Package a trained model into an API and charge per prediction.

steal_this: This is a dev framework, not a product — the real weekend project is picking one narrow prediction problem for a specific small business and shipping a tiny trained model as an API.
